name: Ingredient characters assemble the formula
observedStructure: One ingredient, one symptom, one job; the brand combines the jobs.

name: Apparent apology or warning reveals an offer
observedStructure: Open a reputational concern, affirm product claims, then resolve the concern as a better deal.

name: Initial worsening is reframed as progress
observedStructure: Present an unwanted early experience as evidence of action before promising relief.
psychologicalHypotheses: expectation management; objection preemption; commitment reinforcement

name: Historical progress creates an alleged downstream problem
observedStructure: Acknowledge the benefit of an old intervention, then argue it left a gap that the product restores.

name: Skepticism becomes a counterfeit/official-channel argument
observedStructure: Move from disappointment or copies to authenticity checks and the official purchase destination.
psychologicalHypotheses: loss avoidance; skepticism redirection; purchase confidence

name: Countdown of formulation criteria
observedStructure: Source, potency and pairing become a numbered comparison checklist.

name: Recognizable signs in a list or countdown
observedStructure: Give recognizable entry points and explain each through the preferred account.

name: A sequence of attempted remedies earns a new choice
observedStructure: Chronological failed attempts create the question answered by a claimed expert discovery.
psychologicalHypotheses: effort validation; narrative identification; reason to reconsider

name: A relationship-related cause opens the explanation
observedStructure: A provocative interpersonal explanation transitions into a practical biological story.

name: Reject hygiene blame and explain recurrence
observedStructure: Name a shaming explanation, reject it, validate effort, then propose a new causal account.
psychologicalHypotheses: validation; relief from self-blame; earned authority

name: Admit price, then explain design trade-offs
observedStructure: Agree the product costs money; explain the cheaper choices the brand says it declined and why.
psychologicalHypotheses: two-sided argument; perceived transparency; value justification

name: Separate symptom remedies become one routine
observedStructure: Map symptoms to ingredient jobs, expose cost or complexity, and consolidate into one product.
psychologicalHypotheses: convenience; reduced choice burden; value anchoring

name: A timeline turns mechanism into expected experience
observedStructure: Alternate unseen mechanism and imagined milestones before an everyday outcome.

name: Desired social reaction followed by a modest concession
observedStructure: Stage a desired reaction, concede exaggeration, then translate value into everyday freedom.
psychologicalHypotheses: social recognition; identity expression; two-sided argument

name: Attack misleading category advertising, then differentiate
observedStructure: Voice the viewer’s ad fatigue and substitute a specific product-selection argument.

name: A Reddit-style account supplies the teaching question
observedStructure: Retell a specific unresolved case, interpret failed attempts, and recommend a formulation.
psychologicalHypotheses: identification; borrowed social evidence; explanatory authority

name: Symptoms lead through a claimed obstacle to product criteria
observedStructure: Use recognition, recurrence and a physical analogy to establish a claimed obstacle and solution jobs.

name: Why we built it and which compromises we rejected
observedStructure: Link seller values to specific formulation decisions and dissatisfaction with alternatives.
psychologicalHypotheses: seller trust; motive transparency; value justification

name: Products or foods voice the buyer’s objections
observedStructure: Let an alternative object, then answer with a audience-specific rationale and product roles.
psychologicalHypotheses: vicarious learning; objection resolution; preserving desired activities

name: Deadline or warehouse event gives a reason to buy
observedStructure: Lead with a purported deadline or inventory event, then state discount and action.

name: A season supplies the problem and desired activity
observedStructure: Connect familiar seasonal conditions to a proposed routine and an offer.

name: Condition-specific customer claim or treatment comparison
observedStructure: Call out a condition, claim practitioner/customer support, then give a routine and outcome.

name: Short direct product or category explanation
observedStructure: Quick recognition or a stitched opening leads into product use or category relevance.

name: Music, fragments, or short nondeveloped dialogue
observedStructure: Excluded from developed VSL framework conclusions.
